signIn.title: Back office
signIn.intro: Sign in with your work email. We'll email you a sign-in link.
signIn.codeIntro: If {email} is on the staff list, a sign-in link is on its way. Open it on this device, in this browser. It can take a minute.
signIn.code: Or type the code, if your email shows one
signIn.resent: A new link is on its way.
signIn.badEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
signIn.badCode: That code is wrong or has expired. Check the latest email or send a new code.
signIn.tooMany: Too many tries. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
signIn.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.
signIn.badLink: That sign-in link has expired or was opened in a different browser. Ask for a new link and open it in this browser.

noAccess.title: No access
noAccess.text: {email} is signed in, but isn't on the Thaanora staff list. Ask the owner to add you, then sign in again.
noAccess.sectionText: Your role ({role}) doesn't include {section}. Ask the owner if you need it.

roleText.owner: You can see and change everything.
roleText.orders: You handle orders and customer requests.
roleText.catalogue: You handle products, photos and stock.

dashboard.noOrders: No orders yet. New WhatsApp orders appear here.
dashboard.waitingLine: {count, plural, one {# order waiting} other {# orders waiting}} for WhatsApp confirmation
dashboard.requestsLine: {count, plural, one {# new customer request} other {# new customer requests}}
dashboard.loadFailed: Some figures couldn't load. Please refresh the page.

section.soonText: This section arrives in a later step. Your sign-in and role already protect it.

products.title: Products
products.marginNote: Margin compares the selling price with the Pakistan purchase price at {rate} PKR per SAR. Freight, duty and delivery are not included.
products.marginNoRate: Margin needs the PKR rate, which your account can't read yet.
products.photosHint: Add one or more photos. The main one is shown on the rack. They're resized automatically before uploading.
products.name: Name shown to customers
products.stockNote: Stock {from} → {to} will be recorded as a stock adjustment.
products.added: {name} was added. It's on the website now.
products.saved: {name} was saved. The website shows the change now.

errors.notFound: This product no longer exists. Refresh the page.
errors.stockFailed: Saved, but the stock change couldn't be recorded. Please try again.
errors.codeTaken: That brand code is already used by another product.
errors.photoUnreadable: {name} couldn't be opened. Try a JPG or PNG.
errors.photoTooBig: A photo is too large even after resizing.
errors.somePhotos: Saved, but {count, plural, one {# photo} other {# photos}} couldn't be uploaded. Try adding again.

stock.title: Stock
stock.sub: Suits in your Riyadh storage · {out} sold out · {low} low ({level} or fewer)
stock.receiveNote: The reference is kept in the history so you can match it to your Pakistan invoice.
stock.waiting: {count, plural, one {# customer asked} other {# customers asked}} to be notified about this suit; see Requests.
stock.allStocked: Every suit is above the low-stock level.
stock.latest100: Showing the latest 100 changes. Choose a suit to see its full history.

reasons.refused_at_door: Back in stock · refused at door

errors.notFound: This suit no longer exists. Refresh the page.

orders.title: Orders
orders.sub: Website and WhatsApp orders · cash on delivery
orders.note: Status changes here show on the customer's “Track my order” page straight away. Confirm each order on WhatsApp before packing.
orders.endedCancelled: This order was cancelled. Any stock it held is back on the shelf.
orders.endedRefused: The customer refused this order at the door. Its suits are back in stock.
orders.statusSaved: Status updated: {status}. The customer's tracking page shows it now.
orders.takesStock: takes {count, plural, one {# suit} other {# suits}} off stock.
orders.returnsStock: puts {count, plural, one {# suit} other {# suits}} back in stock.
orders.messageHint: Opens WhatsApp with this text ready, in the language she shopped in. You can edit it before sending.
orders.noPhone: This order has no valid WhatsApp number.
orders.notes: Internal notes (never shown to the customer)
orders.deliveryHint: The courier and tracking number show on the customer's tracking page once the order is with the courier.
orders.name: Name

errors.notFound: This order no longer exists. Refresh the page.
errors.noStock: Not enough stock to confirm this order ({detail}). Receive stock first, or change the order with the customer.

orders.sendFrom: Send it from the shop's WhatsApp (<n>{number}</n>) so replies come back to the shop.
orders.noShopNumber: The shop's WhatsApp number isn't set yet. The owner can add it in Settings.

invoice.title: VAT invoice (Zoho Books)
invoice.later: Created automatically in Zoho Books when the order is Delivered · cash collected.
invoice.issued: Simplified tax invoice {no} created in Zoho Books, cash payment recorded.
invoice.failed: The invoice couldn’t be created in Zoho Books ({count, plural, one {# try} other {# tries}}).
invoice.pending: Creating the invoice in Zoho Books…
invoice.failedNow: The invoice couldn’t be created in Zoho Books yet. It’s listed under Needs attention.
invoice.busy: The invoice is being created right now. Refresh in a moment.
invoice.retryHint: It is also retried automatically every morning.

offers.title: Offers & codes
offers.bundleText: Buy several suits, get a discount
offers.applyBrand: Apply to every suit of this brand
offers.brandNow: {suits, plural, one {# suit} other {# suits}}, {onSale} on sale now
offers.brandHint: Sets the sale % on each suit of the brand (you can still change single suits in Products). Set 0 to end the sale.
offers.codesHint: customers type these in the bag
offers.usedTimes: used {used, plural, one {# time} other {# times}}

done.bundleOn: Bundle offer saved: {qty} suits, {pct}% off. The website uses it now.
done.brandSaleOn: {brand}: {pct}% sale is live on {count, plural, one {# suit} other {# suits}}.
done.brandSaleOff: {brand}: sale ended on {count, plural, one {# suit} other {# suits}}.
done.codeAdded: Code {code} added. Customers can use it now.

errors.forbidden: Only the owner can change offers.
errors.codeFormat: Codes use 2–32 letters, numbers, - or _ (no spaces).
errors.endDate: The last day can't be in the past.
errors.limit: Use limit must be a whole number from 1.

seasons.title: Seasons & labels
seasons.sub: Campaigns, brand of the month and the top-bar messages
seasons.campaignsHint: switch on and off by their dates
seasons.noCampaigns: No campaigns yet. Add one for Eid, Ramadan or National Day.
seasons.topBar: Top-bar messages (they rotate; live campaigns are shown first)
seasons.topBarHint: English is required. Languages left empty show the English text.
seasons.labelsNote: New and trending labels are set on each product under Products.
seasons.needsMigration: Some details couldn't load. If this is the first time, run the Step 30 migration in Supabase.

done.campaignAdded: Campaign “{name}” added. It switches on and off by its dates.
done.labelsSaved: Labels saved. The website shows {count, plural, =0 {the built-in top-bar message} one {# top-bar message} other {# rotating top-bar messages}} now.

errors.forbidden: Only the owner can change seasons and labels.
errors.dates: Choose the first and last day.
errors.datesOrder: The last day must be on or after the first day.
errors.messageEn: Each top-bar message needs English text.

requests.title: Customer requests
requests.none: No requests yet. Requests sent from the website land here.
requests.name: Name
requests.quoteFill: Enter the price and delivery time to prepare the quote.

tailors.title: Tailor network
tailors.sub: Partner tailors shown to customers by area · {listed} of {total} listed
tailors.defaultHint: Used for every tailor without their own %. Customers see it in “Get it stitched”.
tailors.name: Tailor name
tailors.needsMigration: Some details couldn't load. If this is the first time, run the Step 31 migration in Supabase.

done.added: {name} added and listed on the website.

errors.forbidden: Only the owner can change tailors.
errors.name: Add the tailor's name.
errors.phone: Enter a Saudi mobile number (05X XXX XXXX).
errors.pct: Discount must be a whole number from 0 to 50.

settings.title: Settings
settings.sub: Contact details, delivery fees and business information
settings.whatsapp: WhatsApp number (orders and the help button)
settings.socialHint: Paste the full profile link. Leave a link empty to hide it from the footer.
settings.feesHint: Customers choose one of these areas at checkout. The six Riyadh areas are translated automatically; new ones show as typed.
settings.bizHint: Shown in the website footer and on the Privacy and Terms pages. VAT number: 15 digits, once registered.
settings.pricingHint: Neither is ever shown to customers.

done.saved: Settings saved. The website shows the new details now.
done.templates: Templates saved. New messages use them now.

errors.forbidden: Only the owner can change settings.
errors.whatsapp: Enter the WhatsApp number with country code, e.g. +966 5X XXX XXXX.
errors.social: That link isn't a profile link on that network. Use https://… or leave it empty.
errors.fee: Each area needs a name and a fee from 0 to 1000.
errors.feeDuplicate: Two areas have the same name.
errors.feesEmpty: Keep at least one delivery area.
errors.nationalNo: The national number can only have letters, numbers and dashes.
errors.vatNo: A Saudi VAT number has 15 digits.
errors.lowStock: Low-stock level must be a whole number from 0 to 100.
errors.tplUnknown: A template uses a '{'word'}' it can’t fill in (marked in pink). Use only the words listed under it.
errors.tplLong: A template can be at most 1,000 characters.
errors.signinNotReady: SMS sign-in isn't connected yet. Keep Email for now.

settings.tplSub: The ready messages staff send from Orders and Requests. Customers who shop in Urdu or Hindi get the built-in text.
settings.tplHint: Words in '{'braces'}' are filled in for each customer. A line is left out when its detail is empty, for example no tracking number yet.
settings.signinHint: SMS sign-in needs the Taqnyat connection, planned for go-live. Until then customers sign in with a 6-digit email code.

staff.title: Staff & access
staff.sub: Who can sign in and what they can change
staff.name: Name
staff.inviteHint: They open /admin, enter this email and get a sign-in link. Until you connect your own email sender in Supabase, links only reach members of your Supabase team.

done.invited: {name} can now sign in at /admin with {email}.

errors.forbidden: Only the owner can change staff.
errors.name: Add their name.
errors.emailTaken: Someone with that email is already on the staff list.
errors.accountFailed: Added to the staff list, but the sign-in account couldn't be created. Try again in a minute.
errors.self: You can't block yourself or remove your own owner access.
errors.lastOwner: Thaanora needs at least one active owner.

reports.title: Reports
reports.kSales: Sales · {orders, plural, one {# order} other {# orders}} confirmed or later
reports.byDayHint: orders confirmed or later, by the day they were placed
reports.beforeDiscounts: suit prices before bundle and code discounts
reports.codHint: {placed, plural, one {# order} other {# orders}} placed in this period
reports.refusalNote: Refusal rate: {rate} of finished orders (delivered + refused).
reports.csvNote: The CSV has one row per suit ordered, without customer names or phone numbers.
